resolved_conflicts.explanation: The page labels the site Bulkley - Nechako, but the coordinates it gives do not fit that region name. The region is left unconfirmed and no local_unit is set.

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three: one directory entry with coordinates and an elevation (no unit on the page), and no build date, builder, staffing, fate or access data. The story is far below the 120-word floor; the editor may prefer to drop it. A Royal BC Museum archive search snippet lists six photographs titled as views from a Tenas forest lookout (items I-73663 to I-73668, series GR-3263, Forest Service lookout photographs). The archive page could not be fetched (SSL certificate error), so it is not cited and no date or location from it is used. Worth a recheck. The region label Bulkley - Nechako does not fit the coordinates; the brief has no local_unit and none was set. BC Geographical Names has several Tenas features (Tenas Hill, Tenas Lake, Tenas Peak, Tenas Creek) none of which was matched to these coordinates.
